name: PageContent
src_typeComment: One page in a BookPageCurl's page list. Deliberately texture-only (no separate front/back art, no rich text content) — the SAME texture is reused, darkened, for the page's underside while it curls, so authoring a page is just "assign one image." For text/UI-rich pages, render that content to a RenderTexture (or bake it to a Sprite) and assign the result here rather than extending this type.
